patch.value: GH-956: lossless acceptance-criteria replacement and unmatched-removal failure contract
Prevent a composed remove-and-replace update from silently discarding unrelated acceptance criteria; make destructive and unmatched list mutations explicit and machine-actionable.

Unmatched removal fails or requires an explicit allow-noop contract; replacing nonempty acceptance criteria is explicitly named and reports discarded entries; one-entry repair has an atomic operation that preserves unrelated criteria; CLI SDK MCP bulk transaction help and completions share semantics; tests cover delimiter normalization composed flags warnings exits and history atomicity
Make acceptance-criteria mutations lossless and failure-atomic
Agents cannot silently erase closure contracts while repairing one criterion
GitHub #956 demonstrates a successful zero-exit path that destroys unrelated acceptance criteria
Repairing one criterion preserves every unrelated criterion or fails without mutation
An unmatched remove plus replacing --ac exits successfully and drops other criteria
